integrity: The mathematical proof uses exact two-state resolvent algebra, Fourier localization, and a uniform near-critical variational expansion; finite numerical checks independently corroborate normalization and limiting coefficients.
limitations: No assertion about interacting baths, nonlinear strong-probe power, or unforced probe speeds. The variational envelope optimizes all real L2-normalized weak interactions, whereas a nonnegative potential establishes sharp existence only.
scientific_scope: Leading weak-potential mechanical-power coefficient for one-dimensional independent run-and-tumble bath particles with independent translational Brownian diffusion; prescribed probe velocity and real Schwartz probe potential.
title: Sharp thermal suppression and quadratic power-envelope collapse in a one-dimensional active bath
